text:
Elena Gomez: quick note: new quantized bringup (sparrow-lite-int8) is showing EOS-trim artifacts that cause duplicate side-effectful tool calls (payments, emails).
Samir Rao: ugh. any sample?
Elena Gomez: pasted minimal trace from request: 
```
REQ id=req-77 tool=send-email
STREAM chunk1: {"action":"send","to":"user@example.com","subject":"Welcome"}
<stream ended>
client-sdk: parse-failure -> retry
STREAM chunk2: {"action":"send","to":"user@example.com","subject":"Welcome","message_id":"mid-555"}
```
Naomi Park: so first chunk is parseable JSON but client still flagged it because stream ended without trailer header. SDK conservative.
Samir Rao: Is this tied to quant kernel emitting early EOS or network proxy chopping streams?
Elena Gomez: Kernel suspicion: int8 backend sometimes flushes smaller micro-batches early when attention buffers are short -> small duplicated payloads. Proto evidence: rate of truncated-but-parseable chunks correlates with layer-scale variance.
Naomi Park: Impact: duplicate external side-effects. We need multi-layer mitigation: runtime, SDK, and eval harness.
Samir Rao: Runtime idea: add optional "idempotency_token" header from client; runtime keeps short TTL map to dedupe tool forwards. Could be default for side-effecting routes.
Elena Gomez: We already have request_id but it's per-client and can change on retry. Idempotency token would be stable per logical operation.
Naomi Park: SDK change: if a stream ends but accumulated bytes parse as valid JSON, treat as success unless explicit checksum/trailer indicates corruption. Add a single soft-repair attempt: try JSON.parse(buffer) and if ok accept. Backoff only when parse fails.
Samir Rao: That's reasonable but we must be careful for partial JSON that accidentally parses (rare). Need heuristics: require message to include explicit action or tx_id fields present in contract.
Elena Gomez: Good point. For e.g., payment tool must contain either tx_id or status. If not present, still allow SDK accept only when checksum trailer exists.
Naomi Park: Also runtime should expose a machine-readable header from model responses: e.g. "X-Model-Finalized: true/false" sent when model explicitly emits eos_token. That would let SDK decide. Can we push that from serving runtime?
Samir Rao: Short-term: runtime can set a trace-flag in meta when stream completes cleanly; but model-side change needed for consistent emission. Longer-term fix in quant kernel.
Elena Gomez: Proposed rollout plan:
- 1) Add SDK opt-in heuristic that auto-accepts parseable JSON for configured side-effecting tools (Naomi PR).
- 2) Runtime opt-in TTL dedupe keyed by idempotency_token + tool_name for 10s (Samir PR). Use LRU with 1M entries.
- 3) Evals: add chaos test that injects stream-cuts at different boundaries and asserts no duplicate side-effects in 1000 samples (Elena adds to canary harness).
Naomi Park: I'll draft the SDK patch behind feature flag today. Will include guard for actions without tx_id.
Samir Rao: I'll prototype runtime store. Concern: memory and cross-replica consistency. For Dedicated / Private, we should make it optional and document caveats.
Elena Gomez: For cross-replica, we can use a small consistent-store (redis) only when enabled for enterprise customers; hosted can use local cache + sticky routing as fallback.
Samir Rao: Good enough for MVP. Also add server-side detection for duplicate tool invocations using model-generated message_id when present.
Naomi Park: Evals: I'll add a JSTest that simulates:
- random chunk drops at 1-5%
- truncated-but-parseable prefixes
- verify downstream side-effect count == 1
Elena Gomez: Also add telemetry metric: structured_output_retry_ratio and duplicate_toolcall_rate per-model. We'll gate canary rollouts on those.
build-bot: Canary rollout paused: sparrow-lite-int8 at 5% after duplicate_toolcall_rate > 0.5%. Link: https://ci.redwood/canaries/7890
Elena Gomez: Pause is fine. Need triage owner for kernel traces. Naomi can you correlate affected traces with per-layer scales?
Naomi Park: Yep grabbing a sample bundle. Will post link when ready.
Samir Rao: I'll file a long-term ticket for kernel investigation and add test vectors.
Elena Gomez: Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/ML-8101 (eos-trim duplication investigation). Attach sample traces.
ops-bot: Rollback plan available: /ops rollback sparrow-lite-int8. Ops standby if needed. :thumbsup:
Naomi Park: I'll aim to have SDK PR + eval harness test by EOD.
Samir Rao: Runtime prototype PR tomorrow.
Elena Gomez: Thanks team. We'll meet sync at 11am tomorrow for status. End thread.
